Subject: Clarification on Routine Process and Invitation for Questions

Dear Team,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to clarify the routine process for submitting project updates. For your information, submissions should be made via our designated SharePoint folder by the end of each business day. This ensures timely tracking and management of all projects.

If you have any questions or require further clarification, please do not hesitate to reach out. I encourage an open dialogue to ensure everyone is on the same page and any potential issues are addressed promptly.

Looking forward to your feedback and continued cooperation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position] 
[Your Contact Information] 

[Company Name]
